#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Worst-case sized requests: 256 slots x 512 windows, 32 flows, 32 groups."""
import json
import random
import sys


def make(rng, S=256, J=512, F=32, G=32, r1=False, spread=True):
    step = 1000
    times = [s * step for s in range(S)]
    caps = [512] * S
    refill = [0] + [512] * (S - 1)
    groups = []
    for g in range(G):
        parent = -1 if g < 2 else rng.choice([-1, rng.randint(0, g - 1)])
        groups.append([parent, 512 if r1 else rng.choice([0, 3, 17, 512])])
    flows = []
    for f in range(F):
        target = 64 if not r1 else rng.randint(1, 4)
        ceiling = 512
        group = -1 if G == 0 or rng.random() < 0.2 else rng.randint(0, G - 1)
        flows.append([target, ceiling, group, rng.randint(0, 6)])
    windows = []
    for j in range(J):
        f = j % F
        ready = rng.randint(0, times[-1]) if spread else 0
        expires = times[-1] if rng.random() < 0.8 else rng.randint(ready, times[-1])
        windows.append([f, ready, expires, 1, 1, 0, rng.randint(1, 1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0, 1500), rng.randint(0, 2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    return {
        'model': rng.choice(['cnn', 'rnn']),
        'class_values': [rng.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(7)],
        'stats': [100, 100000, 1000000],
        'bucket': [512, 512],
        'slots': [[times[s], caps[s], refill[s]] for s in range(S)],
        'flows': flows,
        'groups': groups,
        'windows': windows,
    }


def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 7
    count = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    cases = [make(rng) for _ in range(count)]
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({'version': 3, 'cases': cases}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
